name: Standing Up For Yourself
overview: Scripture teaches that standing up for yourself involves a commitment to righteousness and obedience to God's commands, which leads to honor and protection above others (Deuteronomy 28:1). The believer is called to avoid the counsel and influence of the ungodly, maintaining separation from sinful ways (Psalms 1:1; Proverbs 18:1). While Scripture warns against yielding to the wicked, as it corrupts one's integrity (Proverbs 25:26), it also reminds us to exercise restraint and accountability in our words and actions, recognizing that even idle speech will be judged (Matthew 5:38; Matthew 12:36).
